name: Button
description: Text action button (Onest 600). primary = teal fill, brand = teal outline, secondary = neutral outline, tertiary = quiet transparent detail action, ghost = transparent, danger = red fill, link = inline teal text.
guidance: USE · Any action with a visible text label / AVOID · Icon-only control → IconButton
paperApi: variant?: "primary"|"brand"|"secondary"|"tertiary"|"ghost"|"danger"|"link" (secondary); size?: "xs" 28|"sm" 32|"md" 36 (sm); leadingIcon?, trailingIcon?: IconName; loading?; fullWidth?; type? (button)

name: IconButton
description: Square icon-only button with a required label (aria-label + tooltip), primary/outline/ghost variants and optional alert dot. Primary uses the same action states as Button primary. `badge` is a dot (true) or a count chip (number, 99+ cap) — the topbar bell shows the unread count.
guidance: USE · Toolbar/topbar controls whose icon is unambiguous (notifications, help, close) / AVOID · The action needs words to be understood → Button with leadingIcon
paperApi: icon: IconName; label: string (required); variant?: "primary"|"outline"|"ghost" (outline); size?: "xs" 28|"sm" 32|"md" 36 (md); badge?: boolean | number; tooltip?: boolean (true)

name: Icon
description: 151 exact SVG glyphs · closed IconName vocabulary · 24 × 24 viewBox

name: Checkbox
description: 18px checkbox (pink when checked/indeterminate) with optional label and description.
guidance: USE · Multi-select in tables and lists (indeterminate for select-all) / AVOID · Setting that applies immediately → Switch
paperApi: checked: boolean|"indeterminate"; onCheckedChange?: (c: boolean) => void; label?; aria-label? (when no label); description?; disabled?

name: Switch
description: On/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately.
guidance: USE · Settings pages and panels where a change applies immediately (enable notifications, auto-assign) / AVOID · Boolean inside a form submitted with Save → Checkbox

name: RadioGroup
description: Single choice from a short, always-visible list of options, each with optional description.
guidance: USE · 2–5 mutually exclusive options that benefit from being visible side by side, with explanations / AVOID · More than 5 options → SelectField or Combobox
paperApi: value: string; onValueChange: (v: string) => void; options: { value, label, description?, disabled? }[]; orientation?: "vertical"|"horizontal"; aria-label?

props.name: options

name: Avatar
description: Rounded person/entity photo or initials with load-error fallback. Default sm26; chip24/radius6 is compact rounded media for Kanban assignees. Existing sizes and tones remain unchanged.
guidance: USE · People: owners, assignees, account menu, activity actors / AVOID · Vendor/hotel logos or thumbnails in tables → EntityCell media
paperApi: name: string|null; src?: string; unassignedLabel?: string; size?: "xs"20|"chip"24|"sm"26|"md"32|"lg"40|"xl"48 (sm); tone?: "person"|"work"|"warm"|"channel"|"neutral" (person); shape?: rounded|circle (deprecated historical previews only; omit for rounded default)

name: StatusChip
description: 28px status pill with tone colours and a leading dot (success, warning, danger, info, neutral).
guidance: USE · Showing a state that is not a known domain status (e.g. a custom sync state) / AVOID · Choosing tone by hand for a domain status (vendor, booking, payment, invoice…) → StatusBadge (domain)
paperApi: tone: "success"|"warning"|"danger"|"info"|"neutral"; dot?: boolean (true); size?: "sm" 22|"md" 28 (md); children

name: Tag
description: 24px soft-rect label chip for categories and attributes, with optional icon and removable ×.
guidance: USE · Attributes/categories on records (languages, amenities, regions) / AVOID · Status of a record → StatusBadge / StatusChip
paperApi: children; icon?: IconName; tone?: "neutral"|"work"|"person" (neutral); size?: "sm" 20|"md" 24 (md); onRemove?: () => void; removeLabel: string (required with onRemove)

name: CountBadge
description: 18px mono count (10.5px) with optional selected/danger tone and max overflow (99+).
guidance: USE · Counts next to tabs, nav items, filter triggers and section titles / AVOID · Unread/alert indicator with no number → IconButton badge
paperApi: count: number; tone?: "neutral"|"selected"|"danger" (neutral); max?: number (99); hideZero?: boolean (false — render nothing when count is 0)

name: IdChip
description: Mono record reference chip with bookmark icon and copy-to-clipboard button (announces "Copied").
guidance: USE · Showing a record's reference/ID in a record header meta row or detail panel so users can copy it / AVOID · Code under an entity name in a table → EntityCell code
paperApi: value: string; icon?: IconName ("bookmark"); copyable?: boolean (true); label?: string ("Reference", used in aria + tooltip)

name: Kbd
description: Keyboard key / shortcut hint (mono 10.5px, muted key cap).
guidance: USE · Showing a keyboard shortcut next to a search field, menu item or in help text / AVOID · Record references → IdChip

name: Spinner
description: Rotating loader arc or refresh arrow in currentColor for indeterminate short waits.
guidance: USE · Inline indeterminate loading inside a small region (a panel refreshing, a lazy menu) / AVOID · Button waiting on an action → Button loading
paperApi: size?: "sm"|"md" (md); variant?: "loader"|"refresh" (loader); label?: string (announced as status)

name: Skeleton
description: Shimmering placeholder block or text lines for loading content (aria-hidden).
guidance: USE · Content with a known shape is loading (cards, panels, text) / AVOID · Table rows loading → DataTable loading
paperApi: width?: string|number; height?: string|number; radius?: "sm"|"md"|"pill" (sm); lines?: number

name: Meter
description: 4px usage bar (pink accent default, on a pink-tinted track; other tones on a neutral track) with optional label and value text; role=meter.
guidance: USE · Credits, quotas, completion percentage, capacity / AVOID · Indeterminate loading → Spinner
paperApi: value: number; max: number; tone?: "accent"|"primary"|"success"|"warning"|"danger" (accent); label?: string; valueText?: string; size?: "sm" 4px|"md" 6px (sm)

name: TextLink
description: Inline teal link, underline on hover; external opens a new tab with an external-link icon.
guidance: USE · Links inside running text, descriptions and table cells (email, website, related record) / AVOID · Standalone action → Button (variant="link" for inline text actions)
paperApi: href?: string; onClick?; external?: boolean; children

name: Tooltip
description: Dark hover/focus tooltip (12px) around a single focusable trigger. Includes its own provider (300ms delay).
guidance: USE · Supplementary hint for a control or truncated value / AVOID · Label for an icon-only button → IconButton (tooltip is built in)
paperApi: content: ReactNode; side?: "top"|"right"|"bottom"|"left" (top); children: ReactElement (trigger); delayDuration?

name: Divider
description: 1px hairline separator, horizontal or vertical.
guidance: USE · Separating groups inside a toolbar, menu-like panel or card body / AVOID · Spacing between page regions → templates own spacing
paperApi: orientation?: "horizontal"|"vertical" (horizontal)

name: Stack
description: Flex layout for a few children inside a region: column (default) or row, gap from the space scale (--pt-space-*), align, justify, wrap; renders div, ul or ol. Classes only, no inline styles.
guidance: USE · A row of actions, chips or tags inside a panel, card or popover / AVOID · Page regions (header, toolbar, table, rail) → templates such as ListPageTemplate, RecordPageTemplate, DashboardPageTemplate
paperApi: direction?: "row"|"column" (column); gap?: "0"|"0-5"|"1"|"1-5"|"2"|"2-5"|"3"|"3-5"|"4"|"5"|"6"|"7"|"8"|"10"|"12"|"14" ("2" = 8px); align?: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline"; justify?: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"; wrap?: boolean; as?: "div"|"ul"|"ol" (div); children; className (placement only)

name: VisuallyHidden
description: Deprecated compatibility for frozen historical previews. For new work use a semantic element with the public pt-visually-hidden utility class. Screen-reader-only text (.pt-visually-hidden): a 1px clipped box anchored to its containing block's top-left, so hidden text inside scrolling tables, boards and matrices never grows the document.
guidance: USE · Rendering an existing frozen historical preview only / AVOID · New screens or updated references → a semantic element with the public pt-visually-hidden utility class
paperApi: as?: "span"|"div" (span); children; …HTMLAttributes (id, role, aria-live)

name: HeadingLevelProvider
description: Sets the heading level that section components (FormSection) use inside a surface. Modal and Sheet already provide 3 because their title is the h2; useHeadingLevel() reads it.
guidance: USE · Building a new surface whose own title is an h2 and which hosts FormSections or other section headings / AVOID · Inside Modal / Sheet → already provided

name: Heading
description: A heading that follows the nearest HeadingLevelProvider.

name: Field
description: Label above a custom control, with hint or error (alert icon) below. Every labelled form component already renders one.
guidance: USE · Labelling a control that has no labelled wrapper of its own (ChoiceChips, Switch group, FileDropzone) / AVOID · Text, select, date, phone or amount inputs → TextField, SelectField, DateField, PhoneField, MoneyField (they include the label)
paperApi: label: ReactNode; htmlFor?: string (hint/error ids = `${htmlFor}-hint` / `${htmlFor}-error`); labelId?: string (for aria-labelledby on non-labelable controls); hint?; error?; optional? (renders "(optional)"); required? (semantics only); span?: "full"

name: TextField
description: Labelled single-line text input, 38px, radius sm, optional leading icon, prefix/suffix, mono value for codes.
guidance: USE · Names, emails, references, short free text in a form / AVOID · Searching or filtering a list → SearchField (no label, 36px, clear button)
paperApi: label; hint?; error?; optional?; span?: "full"; leadingIcon?: IconName; prefix?: string; suffix?: ReactNode; size?: "md" 38|"sm" 32 (md); mono?; readOnly?; onValueChange?: (v: string) => void; …input attributes (go to the <input>; className places the field)

name: TextArea
description: Labelled multi-line text input, vertically resizable by default; focused editors can disable resizing while long text scrolls inside the field. Same frame as TextField.
guidance: USE · Addresses, notes, descriptions, cancellation terms / AVOID · One-line values → TextField
paperApi: label; hint?; error?; optional?; span?: "full"; rows? (3); resize?: "vertical" | "none" (vertical); onValueChange?; …textarea attributes

name: SelectField
description: Labelled single choice from a short fixed list: Radix Select styled as a 38px input with chevron; options show icon, description and a check. Exports type SelectOption = { value, label, icon?, description?, disabled? } shared with Combobox and MultiSelect. Experimental SelectOption.media: { src } renders a decorative saved thumbnail with initials on load failure; photos win over option icons. Single-value triggers show a compact thumbnail; MultiSelect tags retain compact text labels.
guidance: USE · Choosing one of ~3–15 known values inside a form (status, country, vendor type) / AVOID · Filtering a list/table → FilterMenu in ListToolbar (never a labelled SelectField row)
paperApi: label; options: SelectOption[] (media?: { src: string }, experimental); value?: string ("" = placeholder); defaultValue?; onValueChange?: (v: string) => void; placeholder? ("Select…"); hint?; error?; disabled?; required?; optional?; name?; span?

name: Combobox
description: Labelled single choice from a long list with a type-to-filter popover (Radix Popover). The trigger is a select-only combobox (role=combobox, aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded, aria-controls) named by its label. Arrow keys move, Enter selects, Escape closes the list (not the surrounding dialog). Filtering matches label or description and ranks label-starts-with, then label-contains, then description-only matches. Experimental SelectOption.media: { src } renders a decorative saved thumbnail with initials on load failure; photos win over option icons. Single-value triggers show a compact thumbnail; MultiSelect tags retain compact text labels.
guidance: USE · Choosing one of many values: city, country, vendor, customer, hotel / AVOID · Short fixed list (≤ 15) → SelectField
paperApi: label; options: SelectOption[] (media?: { src: string }, experimental); value?: string; onValueChange: (v: string) => void; placeholder?; searchPlaceholder? ("Search…"); emptyText? ("No matches"); leadingIcon?: IconName; hint?; error?; disabled?; required?; optional?; name?; span?; onCreate?: (query: string) => void (experimental: "+ createLabel" action under the list, gets the typed text); createLabel? ("Create new")

name: MultiSelect
description: Labelled multiple choice from a long list: selected values show as removable Tags inside the control (first `max`, then "+N"); popover with filter and checkbox options. The trigger is role=combobox (aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded, aria-controls) named by its label. Filtering matches label or description and ranks label-starts-with, then label-contains, then description-only matches. Experimental SelectOption.media: { src } renders a decorative saved thumbnail with initials on load failure; photos win over option icons. Single-value triggers show a compact thumbnail; MultiSelect tags retain compact text labels.
guidance: USE · Choosing several values from more than 8 options (destinations, languages, regions, team members) / AVOID · ≤ 8 options that should stay visible → ChoiceChips
paperApi: label; options: SelectOption[] (media?: { src: string }, experimental); value: string[]; onValueChange: (v: string[]) => void; placeholder?; max? (3 tags shown); searchPlaceholder?; emptyText?; hint?; error?; disabled?; required?; optional?; span?

name: DateField
description: Labelled civil date (YYYY-MM-DD), editable dd/mm/yyyy input, DS formatted date at rest and the shared DS MiniCalendar popover; no timezone conversion.
guidance: USE · Travel date, due date, date of birth, passport expiry — any calendar date without a time / AVOID · Start and end dates → DateRangeField
paperApi: label; value?: string (YYYY-MM-DD or ""); onValueChange?: (v: string) => void; min?; max?; hint?; error?; optional?; required?; disabled?; readOnly?; span?

name: TimeField
description: Labelled civil local time HH:mm. Type an exact time or choose Hours (00–23) and Minutes (00–59) in two DS dropdowns with shared SelectField anatomy; bound/step-invalid choices are disabled; hour selection keeps the popover open and minute selection closes; 24-hour HH:mm display in every locale; hidden native validation retains min/max (including overnight windows), step and form name.
guidance: USE · Appointment, meeting, pickup or follow-up time entered separately from its date / AVOID · Picking a calendar date → DateField
paperApi: label; value?: string (HH:mm); onValueChange?: (v: string) => void; min?; max?; step? (seconds); hint?; error?; optional?; required?; disabled?; readOnly?; span?; …input attributes

name: DateRangeField
description: Owner-selected presets/stay popover is the default whole civil-date range. ONE DS calendar picks start then end with equally selected endpoints, quick Weekend/1 week presets, clear action and min/max bounds. Inline nights summary, two-endpoint, plain field and content-width compact toolbar variants remain available.
guidance: USE · Stay dates, travel window, rate-card validity, contract period / AVOID · A single date → DateField
paperApi: label; value: { from?: string; to?: string }; onValueChange: (v) => void; fromLabel? ("Start date"); toLabel? ("End date"); min?; max?; orderError?; hint?; error? (wins over orderError); disabled?; required?; optional?; span?. Helper: isDateRangeReversed(value); variant?: "field"|"compact"|"inline"|"presets"|"endpoints" (default presets; owner-selected)

name: MoneyField
description: Labelled amount in major units (number | null): currency symbol prefix from Intl (₹ for INR), right-aligned mono value, digits + one decimal point only, lakh grouping (12,34,567.5) via @paryatech/format as digits are typed, with caret-preserving editing and decimal drafts.
guidance: USE · Prices, costs, deposits, credit limits, markups in currency / AVOID · Displaying an amount → Money or MoneyCell
paperApi: label; value: number | null; onValueChange: (v: number | null) => void; currency? ("INR"); locale? ("en-IN"); hint?; error?; optional?; required?; disabled?; readOnly?; span?

name: PhoneField
description: Labelled phone number: searchable country-name and dial-code popover (+91 India default; UAE, Singapore, UK, US, Australia, Thailand, Malaysia, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Maldives) + tel input in one 38px control.
guidance: USE · Phone or WhatsApp number of a contact, vendor or customer / AVOID · Displaying a phone number → ContactList or TextLink (tel:)
paperApi: label; countryCode: string ("+91"); onCountryCodeChange; value: string; onValueChange; countries?: {code,label}[] (PHONE_COUNTRY_CODES); countryCodeLabel?; hint?; error?; optional?; required?; disabled?; span?; searchPlaceholder? ("Search country or code"); emptyText?

name: SearchField
description: Unlabelled search box (placeholder doubles as aria-label): 36px (md) or 44px (lg), radius md, leading icon, clear × when non-empty, default / Kbd shortcut to focus the first visible search (ignores editable targets; respects active dialogs); Escape clears first — inside a Modal/Sheet/Popover the first Escape clears, the next one closes.
guidance: USE · List toolbars (ListToolbar search) / AVOID · Form input that needs a label → TextField
paperApi: value: string; onValueChange: (v: string) => void; placeholder: string (also the accessible name); shortcut?: string ("/" default; "" opts out; other values are display-only); size?: "md" 36|"lg" 44 (md); icon?: IconName ("search"); clearLabel?; autoFocus?; …input attributes

name: ChoiceChips
description: Soft-rect toggle chips (32px, radius sm, 12.5/600, optional icon). Pressed = pink soft bg + pink border + pink text. multiple (default) = group of aria-pressed buttons; multiple={false} = radiogroup with arrow keys.
guidance: USE · ≤ 8 options that should all stay visible: service categories, trip type, meal plan / AVOID · More than 8 options → MultiSelect
paperApi: options: { value; label; icon?: IconName; disabled? }[]; value: string[]; onValueChange: (v: string[]) => void; multiple? (true); name the group with "aria-label": string and/or "aria-labelledby": string (at least one required, type-enforced; labelledby wins); disabled?

props.name: options

name: SegmentedControl
description: 2–5 mutually exclusive modes in one subtle track (radius md, 2px inset); active segment white + shadow block; optional icon and mono count. radiogroup semantics, arrow keys select.
guidance: USE · Switching how the current content is shown: List | Grid, Day | Week | Month / AVOID · Page sections or record tabs → TabBar
paperApi: options: { value; label; icon?: IconName; count?: number; disabled? }[]; value: string; onValueChange: (v: string) => void; "aria-label": string and/or "aria-labelledby": string (at least one required, type-enforced); size?: "sm" 28|"md" 32|"toolbar" 36 (md); disabled?

props.name: options

name: QuantityField
description: Labelled whole-number stepper: − / mono value / + with min, max and step. The input is a spinbutton (arrows, PageUp/Down, Home/End) and accepts typed digits, clamped on blur.
guidance: USE · Counts in a form: travellers, rooms, nights per city, vehicles, seats / AVOID · Money amounts → MoneyField
paperApi: label; value: number; onValueChange: (v: number) => void; min? (0); max? (99); step? (1); unit?: { one; other } (spoken value + button names); layout?: "stacked"|"inline" (stacked); hint?; error?; optional?; required?; disabled?; readOnly?; span?

name: PaxSelector
description: Traveller-count field: a 38px trigger summarising the party ("2 adults · 1 child (7) · 1 room") that opens a popover with steppers for adults (min 1), children with one age select each (2–11), infants, and optionally rooms and extra beds.
guidance: USE · Pax on a query, booking, package or quote form / AVOID · A single count (rooms only, seats) → QuantityField
paperApi: label; value: PaxValue { adults; children; infants; childAges: (number|null)[]; rooms?; extraBeds? }; onValueChange; fields?: PaxField[] (children, childAges, infants; add rooms, extraBeds; flights: ["infants"]); maxTotal? (99); labels?: PaxLabels ({ rooms: { label: "Cabins", one: "cabin", other: "cabins", hint? } } — renames a row everywhere: label, stepper names, summary, description); placeholder?; hint?; error? (also flags unanswered ages); optional?; required?; disabled?; span?. Helpers: paxSummary(value, fields?, labels?), paxTotal(value), syncChildAges(ages, n), CHILD_AGE_MIN/MAX

name: FormSection
description: One section of a sectioned form: intro column (--pt-size-form-intro) with a 34px (--pt-size-form-intro-tile) teal icon tile, Onest 15/700 title and 12.5px description, beside the fields. Hairline between sections; stacks to one column under 760px of its own width. Title is h2 on pages and h3 inside Modal/Sheet automatically.
guidance: USE · Create pages (inside FormPageTemplate) with more than ~6 fields: Identity, Primary contact, Location, Business details / AVOID · ≤ 4 fields in a small modal → FormGrid alone in Modal size="sm"
paperApi: title: string; description?: string; icon?: IconName; headingLevel?: 2 | 3 (default: 2 on pages, 3 inside Modal/Sheet); id? (anchor for Modal nav); children (FormGrid…)

name: FormGrid
description: Responsive grid of fields: 1/2/3 columns (row gap 16, column gap 20). Fields with span="full" span every column. Collapses 3→2 under 720px and to 1 under 480px of available width (container query).
guidance: USE · Laying out fields inside a FormSection, Modal, Sheet or Popover / AVOID · Page-level layout → templates (FormPageTemplate, RecordOverviewLayout)
paperApi: columns?: 1|2|3 (2); children (fields; span="full" to span)

name: FormFooter
description: Action row at the end of a form: right-aligned actions (Cancel, then primary), optional start slot. sticky (default) = 72px translucent bar with shadow sticky at the bottom of the page; sticky={false} on settings pages and inside Modal/Sheet footers. Under 560px of its own width the start slot stacks above the actions; actions keep natural width (a Cancel + primary pair splits the row).
guidance: USE · Create/edit pages (FormPageTemplate footer) / AVOID · Page-level actions not tied to a form → PageHeader actions
paperApi: sticky?: boolean (true); start?: ReactNode; children (Buttons: secondary Cancel, then primary)

name: Modal
description: Medium content that fits without scrolling. Header → body → right-aligned footer. Source sm width 480px. Avoid deep previews and long forms → full page.

name: ConfirmDialog
description: Small alert dialog asking the user to confirm one action: title question, consequence, Cancel + danger/primary confirm. Awaits an async onConfirm with a loading button and blocks dismissal until it settles.
guidance: Use: Before a destructive or irreversible action (delete, archive, cancel booking)
Avoid: Collecting more than a reason field → Modal size="sm"

name: Popover
description: Anchored panel for a small task beside its trigger, with optional title header (close button) and a footer band. Escape and outside click close; focus returns to the trigger by default. Optional lifecycle handlers support a compact picker beside an external search without moving that input into the panel.
guidance: Use: Anchored mini-task like Import (Steps + FileDropzone), width="lg" with title and footer
Avoid: Medium content (a short form, a list that needs the screen's attention) → Modal; anything that scrolls → a full page

name: Menu
description: Action menu from a trigger. Items are data (MenuItem[]): icon + label, optional description (account-style rich rows), shortcut hint, trailing chevron for rows that open another page (`navigates`), labels as overline group headings, checkbox items and radio groups with a leading check column, and an optional non-interactive `header` (identity block). Destructive items are always moved to a final red group behind an automatic separator.
guidance: Use: Row actions in a table (IconButton "more-vertical" → Menu); DataTable rowActions builds this for you
Avoid: Choosing a form value → SelectField

name: toast
description: Imperative feedback after an action: toast({ title, description?, tone?, action? }). Renders in the Toaster (bottom-right, 360px), auto-dismisses after 5s, pauses on hover/focus, announced politely (danger assertively).
guidance: Use: Confirming an action finished ("Vendor saved", tone success)
Avoid: Validation errors in an open form → field error props

name: Toaster
description: Mount point that renders toasts raised with toast(). Portalled bottom-right stack at --pt-z-toast.
guidance: Use: Mount once at the app root — AppShell already mounts it; only mount it yourself outside AppShell
Avoid: Mounting it per page or inside AppShell pages → it is already there; call toast()

name: PageHeader
description: Import

name: Panel
description: Bordered section card (radius lg) with a raised head (Onest 15/700 title, mono meta, actions), a 16/20 body or full-width body, and an optional footer disclosure. An EmptyState placed directly in the body (or as ItemList/DataTable `empty`) renders bare — the panel is the card.
guidance: Use: Sections of a record overview: Profile, Vendor contacts, Recent activities
Avoid: Sections of a form → FormSection
states: Padded body with a footer / light
Meta and an icon action / light

name: RecordHeader
description: Two-line record header: title and optional tags, then region/parent region and record metadata. Current headers omit status; deprecated status accepts frozen preview content only. Detail edit actions use tertiary Buttons. Optional moreActions renders a contextual ghost kebab beside tertiary Edit; empty/all-disabled actions omit it.
guidance: Use: Top of a vendor, service, booking, customer or package detail page (RecordPageTemplate header)
Avoid: Record page with a list-style PageHeader → RecordHeader
states: Customer with initials and a tag / light

name: IconText
description: Inline context icon + text (inherits size and colour) for meta rows: location with map-pin, date with calendar.
guidance: Use: RecordHeader meta items
Avoid: Table cells → IconTextCell

name: PersonInline
description: Avatar (xs 20 / sm 26, person-pink by default) + name 13.5/600 (+ optional micro subtitle) inline, for detail lists: Owner, Assignee, Created by. Decorative avatar; the name is the text.
guidance: Use: Owner / assignee / relationship manager values in a DescriptionList or ItemList
Avoid: Table cells → PersonCell
states: Owner in a detail list / light
Owner in a detail list / dark

name: Money
description: Money in mono tabular figures with Indian grouping via @paryatech/format (₹4,20,100); paise only when non-zero unless decimals="always"; success/danger/muted tones; sizes sm (12) · md (13.5, default) · lg (15) · xl (fluid 18–22) from the type scale; compact notation (₹4.2L, exact amount in the tooltip and for screen readers); struck for a previous price (<s>, announced "was ₹…"). Experimental `masked`: "••••" announced "Amount hidden" for a hide-amounts eye button (privacy screen, not cost hiding).
guidance: Use: Any amount outside a DataTable cell: KpiStrip values, DescriptionList values, totals
Avoid: Table cells → MoneyCell

name: DateText
description: A civil date (YYYY-MM-DD, never timezone-shifted) or an instant (IST) in a <time> element: '12 Dec 2026', with optional time or relative ('3 months ago').
guidance: Use: Dates in DescriptionList values, meta rows, panels
Avoid: Table cells → DateCell
states: Relative to a pinned now / light

name: DescriptionList
description: Ruled key/value grid (dl/dt/dd): quiet sentence-case keys and strong values that can be nodes (StatusBadge, Avatar + name, mono IDs).
guidance: Use: Record profile fields in an Overview tab
Avoid: Editable fields → FormSection + FormGrid

name: SummaryStrip
description: Deprecated compatibility for frozen historical previews. For new work use KpiStrip with real scoped navigation. Ruled KPI strip: 48px pink icon tiles, overline labels (never clipped), Onest/mono values coloured by tone, hints. Columns follow the strip's own width: 4 → 2 at ≤ 900px; ≤ 620px every strip is 2 compact columns (small inline icon); 1 column only at ≤ 340px — an 8-item strip is 4 short rows on a phone. Bleeds to the page edges inside RecordOverviewLayout and DashboardPageTemplate.
guidance: Use: Rendering an existing frozen historical preview only
Avoid: New screens or updated references → KpiStrip with real scoped navigation

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; value: ReactNode; hint?: string }[]

name: Banner
description: Deprecated compatibility for frozen historical previews. For new work use toast or accessible inline alert/status text. Flash banner with a 3px tone rule on a tinted status surface: title, optional body, one action and Dismiss. role=status (alert for danger). Below 560px of its own width (phones, 360px rails) the action moves under the text so the title keeps the full width.
guidance: Use: Rendering an existing frozen historical preview only
Avoid: New screens or updated references → toast or accessible inline alert/status text

name: EmptyState
description: Centered bordered card with a 44px context-icon tile, Onest title, one-line description and actions. Variants: first-use, no-results ("Clear filters"), error (danger tile, "Try again"), permission (lock). size sm for panels.
guidance: Use: DataTable has no rows (pass as `empty`)
Avoid: Always using the map-pin (or any one) icon → pick the context icon, or rely on the variant default

name: ItemList
description: Header-less ruled rows for rails and panels: [16px muted icon] label 13.5/500 (+ quiet meta line) · right-aligned value (mono optional, blank → '—') · one trailing action (IconButton xs ghost). 48px min rows, hairlines, 20px panel gutter; the value drops under the label below 320px. Values stay aligned when only some rows have actions. Long values (account numbers, e-mails) wrap inside a column capped at 60% of the row, so they never squeeze the label.
guidance: Use: Important dates, bank details, travel documents summary in a record rail
Avoid: Tabular data with sortable columns → DataTable

props.name: items

name: ContactList
description: People to reach for a record: avatar, name, role, Primary tag and Call / Email / WhatsApp pills (tel:, mailto:, wa.me), with a 'View all N contacts' disclosure.
guidance: Use: Vendor / customer contacts in a record rail Panel
Avoid: Selecting people → Combobox/MultiSelect
states: Rail contacts, expand in place / light
View all opens another view / light

name: Steps
description: Owner-selected bounded checklist rail (cards) is the default: numbered upcoming/current steps, checked completed steps, a completion count and the current upload/action area. Explicit numbered instructions, horizontal wizard and compact segmented variants remain available.
guidance: Use: Import modal (download template → upload file → review)
Avoid: Setup progress with done state → Checklist

props.name: steps
props.type: { id: string; label: string; description?: string }[]

name: Checklist
description: Setup checklist: title with a right-aligned '2 of 5 done' count, full-width progress bar under the header, check-circle / circle-dashed items and an action per open item. Framed as its own card by default (no Panel needed); inside a Panel body the frame drops.
guidance: Use: Finish-setup guidance on draft records
Avoid: Selecting options → Checkbox / ChoiceChips

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; checked: boolean; disabled?: boolean }[]

name: FileDropzone
description: Single-file drop target: dashed card with upload icon, 'Drop file or Browse' and accepted-types hint; selected state shows name, 'Ready to import · size', Replace and remove. Rejects files outside accept.
guidance: Use: Import flows (Steps inside an Import Popover)
Avoid: Image galleries / multiple uploads → a dedicated media uploader (not yet in the system; document the gap)

name: TabBar
description: Use for page and record sections. Pink marks selection in both primary (44px) and secondary (40px). Avoid settings section forms → SettingsPageTemplate nav.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: "CRM › Vendors" trail in the topbar: 13.5px, links secondary, current page 600 with aria-current=page. When the trail does not fit, crumbs collapse from the front into a "…" button whose menu lists (and navigates to) the hidden crumbs; the parent goes before the current page is truncated, so the current page always gets the most room.
guidance: Use: Always through AppShell `breadcrumbs` — [Module, Page] on lists, [Module, List, Record] on records
Avoid: Rendering <Breadcrumbs> inside page content → pass breadcrumbs to AppShell

name: BackButton
description: 36px bordered chevron-left button left of the breadcrumbs on record, detail and create pages.
guidance: Use: Through AppShell `onBack` (+ optional backLabel "Back to vendors")
Avoid: A "Back" text button in page content → AppShell onBack

name: Pagination
description: 30px mono pager: previous/next chevrons, pages with ellipses (1 … 4 5 6 … 20), pink current page with aria-current=page.
guidance: Use: Paging outside a table (card grids, search results)
Avoid: Table footers → TableFooter, which wraps Pagination with "Showing 1–12 of 12 vendors"

name: DataTable
description: A semantic table with sorting, controlled row selection, and responsive overflow.

name: EntityCell
description: Two-line primary entity cell: optional rounded media, title with inline tags, and one secondary line combining mono code and subtitle.
guidance: Use: First column of every record list (vendor, customer, service, package, booking)
Avoid: Plain text name in the first column → EntityCell
states: Vendor with photo and code / light
Customer initials with agency tier / light
Vendor with photo and code / dark

name: PersonCell
description: Owner / assignee / contact cell: 26px person avatar + name (13.5/600) with optional inline tags + optional 11.5px sub-line.
guidance: Use: Owner, assignee, agent or primary contact column
Avoid: The row IS a person record (customer list) → EntityCell with media tone "person"

name: StackCell
description: Two-line cell: primary 13.5px over a 12.5px muted secondary line; mono option for references.
guidance: Use: A value plus context ("4 travellers" / "2 adults, 2 children"; trip name / dates)
Avoid: Record name + code → EntityCell

name: MoneyCell
description: Right-aligned mono amount via @paryatech/format ("₹3,00,000", Indian grouping, no ".00") with an optional note line ("₹30,000 due").
guidance: Use: Any money column (total value, balance, rate) — set the column align "end"
Avoid: Formatting money by hand or with toLocaleString → MoneyCell / Money

name: DateCell
description: Mono date "12 Dec 2026" or range "12–16 Dec 2026" (`to`) via @paryatech/format; civil YYYY-MM-DD dates never shift by timezone. Optional calendar icon, danger tone for overdue.
guidance: Use: Travel dates, due dates, created/updated columns
Avoid: Formatting dates by hand → DateCell / DateText

name: TableFooter
description: Footer under a DataTable: mono "Showing 1–12 of 12 vendors" (en-IN numbers, "No vendors" at 0) + Pagination on the right. `sticky` docks it to the bottom of its scroll parent (surface background, top rule) for record tabs.
guidance: Use: Under every paginated DataTable on a list page (ListPageTemplate `footer` slot; contained and paginated dock it, page follows rows) or record tab
Avoid: A bare Pagination under a table → TableFooter (it adds the range text and gutter alignment)
states: Sticky in a record tab / light

name: BulkActionBar
description: Pink 56px band shown while rows are selected: "2 vendors selected" + bulk actions + Clear. Sticky above the TableFooter; gutter-aligned; count announced politely.
guidance: Use: A DataTable with selection offers actions on many rows (Export, Archive, Assign)
Avoid: Primary page actions → PageHeader actions
states: Bulk actions on selected vendors / light
Custom clear label and three actions / light
Bulk actions on selected vendors / dark

name: StageLabel
description: 8px tone dot + label for a workspace-configurable stage (New, Quoting, Options sent, Vouchers pending). md 13.5/600 for column headers; sm 12.5/500 for table cells and previews. Takes the board column ({ label, tone }).
guidance: Use: Stage column in a DataTable list view of a board
Avoid: Fixed domain statuses → StatusBadge; configurable stages → StageLabel
states: Stage column in the list view / light
Stage next to a domain status / light
Stage column in the list view / dark

name: PriorityDot
description: Accessible named priority marker. Default preserves8px urgent/high/medium/low vocabulary. Card appearance uses a solid10px marker and is selected by standard KanbanCard; name and tooltip always identify the level.
guidance: Use: Priority on a KanbanCard (KanbanCard priority prop renders it)
Avoid: Priority as a table column or filter option → EnumLabel / IconTextCell with PRIORITY_LEVELS[p].icon + label (text, not colour only)
states: Before a title in a compact list / light

name: KanbanSignal
description: Named due/age/flag signal with complete accessible date/state. Default preserves StatusChip semantics and appearance; appearance="card" is a24px rounded reference capsule with pale upcoming due and solid overdue. describeKanbanSignal keeps the same classification for tables and filters.
guidance: Use: Deadlines or transient workflow flags on KanbanCard → use appearance="card" for the owner reference anatomy
Avoid: Fixed domain statuses (booking, payment, vendor…) → StatusBadge

name: KanbanCard
description: Standard reference-led card with natural content height: code/priority, one resting title line that expands fully in normal flow,24px deadline and structured related-record capsule, mono short age, rounded chip24 assignees with accessible overflow. Related contextLabel is separate from label and native href. Pointer preview follows50ms entry/300ms expansion/1500ms hold/300ms collapse; focus and touch retain full text, reduced motion is immediate. Rich/compact retain their supported anatomy. Inside Board canonical source IDs, Move/Open/Pin menus, keyboard dragging, async pending and readOnly remain meaningful. Current DS Public Sans is the owner-selected font adaptation.
guidance: Use: Rendering an item in KanbanBoard renderCard
Avoid: Generic content cards or panels → Panel
states: Owner reference · structured related record / light
Owner reference · structured related record / dark

name: PriceChip
description: A price with its change against a previous version: mono INR amount + a toned pill "↑ 8.6%" / "↓ 4.2%" / "–" / "New". Tone follows goodDirection (default "down" for vendor costs: up = warning, down = success). Screen readers hear "up 8.6% from v3 (₹7,000)". Internal pricing only.
guidance: Use: A cost or sell column in a DataTable that should show movement since the last rate-card version (supplements, versions, vendor comparisons)
Avoid: A plain amount → Money (text) or MoneyCell (tables)

name: SeasonHeader
description: Season name and dates on one horizontal line, with a tone swatch (peak/high/shoulder/low), compact mono date-range chips ("20 Dec – 5 Jan") and a red blackout count; full dates with years, blackout reasons and the optional season rule are in accessible text and hover details. It is RateMatrix's column-group header; use it alone where a season is labelled outside the grid (quote lines, test-rate results).
guidance: Use: Labelling a season with its dates outside a RateMatrix (e.g. a night-by-night price breakdown)
Avoid: Inside a RateMatrix → pass the season as a group; the matrix renders SeasonHeader itself
